data.headline: Brewery shelf stocking, stock rotation and store deliveries
data.summary: They stock beverages in stores, rotate products, remove expired items and place orders through a phone app. They drive between several stores each day.

signals.rendering: They stock shelves with beer and soft drinks in stores for a brewery.
They drive by car between six or seven stores each day.
They check product dates, move older bottles forward and remove expired items.
They count missing products and place stock orders through an app on their phone.
